The two boards in this pair paint it two different ways for two states that

130:798 approved  --color/success-tint #DEF7EC ground, success-text
#057A55 label
130:201 pending   --color/warning-tint #FDFDEA ground, ink-soft label

Live, both are gray-100 / ink-soft. That is not drift, it is a written rule:
Topbar.tsx's REVIEW_TONE_CLASS says 'neutral-unless-blocking — info and
success are visually identical by design; only warning gets its own look',
because the bar's colour budget belongs to the two signals that GATE a
publish (the Issues chip and save trouble), and D7 rule 6 caps the bar at two
ambers at once. Painting 'In review' amber spends the third.
So: three boards, two of them mine, disagree with a chrome-ui primitive that
the twelve Shell-state boards already hold at authority=code:topbar. One
screen board does not move that, and neither do two that contradict each
other. Numbers are in measured/<surface>.json; the call is the founder's.
